Klasse RINGwars_7172397_Shogo_Seifert

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.RINGwars_7172397_Shogo_Seifert
public class RINGwars_7172397_Shogo_Seifert extends Object
Entry point with the main method and main orchestration of the agent program.

The RINGwars_7172397_Shogo_Seifert coordinates the execution of one game step. It controls flow and input/output handling on a high-level but does not contain any strategic or logic decision making.

For each step, the AgentController executes these actions:

  • parses the command line arguments step and name,
  • initializes a StepReader,
  • reads and initializes the current and previous GameModel (if available),
  • initializes the StepAnalyzer and AbstractStrategyDecider as analysis and strategy components,
  • initializes a MoveWriter and writes the generated move in the move.txt file.
The agent controller remains a strict orchestration layer, all analyitcal and strategic responsibilities are delegated to other components.
